records.title: docs: reconcile comprehensive Arvin product contract with current capabilities
records.body:
Refs #403 #357 #361 #367 #369 #370 #371 #372 #375 #389 #394 #438.

Comprehensive documentation review after the owner requested a full reconciliation of this conversation and the rolling two-day Arvin history while software production continues in parallel.

## Scope now covered
- re-audit `docs/PRODUCT_CONTRACT_MATRIX.md` against live main, current code/tests, owner Issues and meaningful Aug 27–28 delivery
- keep the matrix as Arvin's comprehensive cross-surface product contract/status registry; no competing comprehensive document
- record Home approved identity plus #369 scopes/sorting/Move-to-Today
- record #370 safe Back/autosave contract and explicit Cancel zero-write boundary
- record #371 category/tag lifecycle and bulk reuse
- retain final FollowUp contract: add/edit/history, blank→`پیگیری`, derived elapsed/inter-FollowUp intervals, latest-real-FollowUp semantics and Jalali/Persian presentation
- retain canonical dueDate independence, recurrence/Resume From Today, Reminder delivery convergence and Widget/Lock Screen requirements
- retain Vazirmatn production/PDF typography
- retain Prayer Times and Daily Content as existing informational Calendar capabilities while excluding them from #438 work-only reports
- reconcile #438 Today/selected-day/date-range work agenda with existing report/PDF/Print/Share foundations
- refresh `docs/DOCUMENT_AUTHORITY_INDEX.md` with active two-day owner/implementation references and the separation between product truth vs operational automation/CI authority

## Governance / automation review
`docs/ARVIN_PROJECT_OPERATING_PACKAGE.md` v49.0 remains the canonical execution/automation authority and already requires reuse-before-add, Maximum Parallel safety, exact evidence and no duplicate foundations. Operational rules are referenced rather than duplicated into the product matrix. The existing hourly `Arvin Maximum Parallel` automation has been re-enabled/strengthened to reconcile recent owner decisions into canonical docs in parallel with product delivery without blocking healthy lanes.

## Safety
- documentation-only
- no product code/model/store/storage/workflow changes in this PR
- no competing comprehensive document
- historical records preserved
- temporary audit marker removed; final diff remains canonical docs only

Keep Draft for exact-head Fast and current-main reconciliation. Merge only when it will not unnecessarily stale healthier production lanes.
